move: six blurred gradient petals orbit an ellipse, rotate and squash, multiply-blending
how: Six rounded-blob divs, each a warm linear gradient (pink, peach, lilac, gold, rose, mint) with mix-blend-mode multiply, live inside a field blurred by filter blur(22px) on a pale peach background. A seek function places each petal on an ellipse (rx 260-340, ry 130-160) at phase i/6, using x/y = cos/sin of one full revolution per D, spins it a full turn (alternating direction) and breathes scaleX 1±0.15 / scaleY 1∓0.1 at twice the orbit rate. Everything is a whole number of cycles per D so the last frame matches the first. A small dark dot at top and a serif italic caption at the bottom stay still.
adapt: Change the six petal gradients and the background, the caption line, and the petal size or count; the ellipse radii can grow for a wider frame. Keep one orbit and one rotation per D and the 2x breathing so it still loops.
port: mount(el, shot) creates the blurred field and six petal divs plus the caption; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one linear tween of a progress object (0 to 1 over D) whose onUpdate runs the seek maths and gsap.sets each petal, because the original drives it with fx.register rather than a timeline. Scope querySelectorAll(".p") to el.
caveats: filter: blur(22px) on a full-frame container with six multiply-blended layers is slow to render
motion is a seek function, not tweens; port it as a progress tween with onUpdate
